message.content:
## Verification Results Summary

All three claims were checked against the AMZN Q1 2024 10-Q (filed 2024-05-01) and Q2 2024 10-Q (filed 2024-08-02), both within the `as_of` cutoff of 2024-08-02.

| Claim | Status | Key Finding |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| **C1** – AWS sales +17% YoY in Q1 2024 | ✅ **Supported** | Direct quote: *"AWS sales increased 17% in Q1 2024 compared to the comparable prior year period."* (AMZN-2024Q1, ¶471) |
| **C2** – Q1 2024 operating income was $4.8B | ⚠️ **Conflicted** | $4.8B was **Q1 2023** operating income. Q1 2024 operating income was **$15.3B**. The claim misattributes the prior-year figure to the current year. (AMZN-2024Q1, ¶482) |
| **C3** – Trainium held 70% of global inference market share, June 2024 | ❌ **Insufficient** | No evidence in any available SEC filing. Market-share statistics of this nature are not reported in AMZN's 10-Q/10-K filings. |

---
